name: What should you do after a DUI arrest in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: What should you do after a DUI arrest in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a DUI arrest, seek immediate legal counsel, avoid making statements to police, and prepare for license suspension and court hearings. An attorney can fight charges and negotiate penalties.hillstonelaw+1​
